summary: Shadows around (or inside) the box, without affecting layout.
details: Each shadow is x-offset, y-offset, blur, spread and colour. List several, comma-separated, to layer a tight shadow with a soft one for a natural look. inset draws the shadow inside the box, and a zero-blur shadow with spread acts as an extra border that takes no space.

values.note: A subtle shadow for a resting card.
Larger and softer: the element looks lifted.
Two layers: tight contact plus soft depth.
Pressed in, like a text field.
No blur, 3px spread: a ring that takes no space.

gotcha: Pure black shadows look harsh. Use black or a dark tint at low alpha (0.1–0.25) and let the blur do the work.
